_note_net_irrigation: Added 24 Oct 09:45 (Thread 1 number check). 'net_irrigation_mm' above is v1 (scripts/water_balance.py, the named year types: dry = WY1994). The live sheet bergama_water_balance_v2.py uses a daily FAO-56 soil balance and ranks the 34 annual totals (dry5 = 80th percentile), so olive 1-in-5 dry = 720.1 mm there against 681.7 mm here. The design storage comes from v2, so scripts that size or print water per hectare read v2 (water_balance_results.json, key net_irrigation_mm).
